G_E6_C1_exact.required: identical tokens over 3 x 512, both arms deterministic

claim_boundary: 512-token causal rollouts on this GPU at capacity 72, three prompt domains, three arms base/ervf/base so the repeat bounds drift. Exactness is a hard gate over every generated token. Latency is end-to-end per-token wall time including the synchronisation; p95/p99 are over 511 timed steps per domain. Context grows during the rollout, so these numbers are not comparable to n7b's frozen fixed-depth figures, and they may not be added to other component gains.
